name: M.M.LaFleur
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $189 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's workwear — dresses, suiting, knit 'Jardigan' jackets, trousers and tops, mostly $250–$550 — sold through its own website, showrooms and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2013 by Sarah LaFleur.

quote.q: Clothing was a really, really powerful way of not just getting other people to see you in that light but also you yourself.

opview: “Clothing was a really, really powerful way of not just getting other people to see you in that light but also you yourself.” — Sarah LaFleur, founder and CEO, Fortune

facts_read.source: brand site (Our Story, Jardigans, October Collection, product page); Fortune 2023-09-06; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue search and item pages; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: 5 open showrooms/stores (NYC, 2x DC, Boston, Philadelphia). Chicago showroom 'relocating, reopening Fall 2026' — no address, not rowed. Boston address conflict: index 89 Newbury St vs store page 134 Newbury Street.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 75 of 977 clothing styles, proportional by product type; census from /products.json (2,093 products incl. jewellery, shoes, sleepwear, hosi

tech_evidence.names: OrigamiTech; Recycled WonderTex; PowerStretch; 365 Stretch Knit; OrigamiPlush; CloudWeave; (Eco) Better Than Denim
tech_evidence.owned: owned (house-named fabrics, sold by name in every product title)
tech_evidence.share: 11% (110 of 977 styles carry one of the named fabrics; 20 of 75 sampled)

craft_evidence.owned: no — the brand owns no factory; it lists its makers
craft_evidence.makers: yes, brand-level — /pages/our-factories names 16 factories with city, founding year and certifications (e.g. Shenzhen WCX Garment Co., Kargisan Karabuk Giyim in Karabük, Tonglu Spring River Knitting i
craft_evidence.mills: none named on product pages ('Italian Wool Twill', 'Italian Jersey' name origins only)
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 75 sampled product pages state a country
craft_evidence.process: partial — the factories page gives each maker's speciality, workforce and certifications; no product-level process
craft_evidence.reasoning: M.M.LaFleur names every factory it uses — sixteen of them, each with city, founding year, workforce figures and audits — which is checkable making, though it owns none and product pages do not tie a style to a maker or state a country. Names its makers, owns nothing: a 3.
